Install on iPhone / iPad · prepare for your flight
  1. Open this site in Safari while online and sign in if asked.
  2. Tap Share → Add to Home Screen. Keep “Open as Web App” enabled if shown, then tap Add.
  3. Open Bonjour Angers from your Home Screen while still online. Wait for “Ready for offline practice”.
  4. Turn on Airplane Mode, close the app, and reopen it to check before departure.

✓ You’re running the installed app. Wait for the ready status here before your flight.

Lessons, dialogues, quizzes and progress work offline. Audio uses your device’s French voice; test playback in Airplane Mode. Written pronunciation hints are always available. Progress stays on each device; iOS may keep Safari and the Home Screen app’s storage separate. Keep the app installed and avoid clearing website data.

Made for real conversations. One small step at a time. 🇫🇷   Angers, France
